title: NOC — Command Center
description: NOC wallboard for any set of routers, switches and firewalls: choose Device Type and any number of Devices at the top (kept in the URL). Everything is read from Zabbix — host groups, hosts, item tags and names; nothing is hardcoded.

list.name: devtype
list.label: Device Type
list.description: Zabbix host groups per device type (regex over group names); set once by 'install.sh --dashboards'

list.name: device
list.label: Devices
list.definition: Zabbix hosts in the host groups of the selected Device Type
list.description: Any number of Zabbix hosts of the chosen type (type to search). All = every host of the type; kept in the URL.

panels.title: Selected devices
panels.description: Devices in the fleet table (the current Device selection).

panels.title: UP
panels.description: Selected devices whose ICMP / SNMP / agent availability reports reachable.

panels.title: DOWN
panels.description: Selected devices that Zabbix reports unreachable (ICMP / SNMP / agent) and nothing reports reachable.

panels.title: UNKNOWN
panels.description: Selected devices with no availability answer: no ICMP/SNMP/agent item, 'unknown', or no data in the last 15m.

panels.title: High / Disaster problems
panels.description: Zabbix triggers in PROBLEM state with severity High or Disaster on the selected devices (monitored hosts, dependent triggers skipped).

panels.title: Fleet health — selected devices
panels.description: One row per selected device, DOWN first. Status: UP = ICMP ping, SNMP or Zabbix agent availability reports reachable; DOWN = they only report unreachable; UNKNOWN = no answer, 'unknown', or nothing reported in the last 15m. CPU / Memory: highest current value of the items tagged component: cpu / component: memory; — = not reported. Click a device to open NOC — Device Health. A device is listed when Zabbix has at least one of these items for it.

panels.title: Active problems — selected devices
panels.description: Zabbix problems of the selected devices, newest first (Zabbix plugin Problems panel). Acknowledged problems are marked.

panels.title: CPU utilization — top 10 of the selected devices
panels.description: The 10 highest CPU series (peak in the time range) among the selected devices: items tagged component: cpu, one line per CPU / engine / plane. Legend sorted by current value.

panels.title: Memory utilization — top 10 of the selected devices
panels.description: The 10 highest memory series (peak in the time range) among the selected devices: items tagged component: memory. Legend sorted by current value.
